# Specs

<!-- Generated by seed-golden-context | Last updated: 2026-05-11 -->

This directory holds implementation-level specs for active or recent work in `contentful/laravel`.

Specs are small, focused documents that capture "what we're building now" — useful for both humans and AI agents working on the repo. Once work is shipped, mark the spec with `status: done` at the top rather than deleting it.

## Naming Convention

```
YYYY-MM-DD-short-description.md
```

Example: `2026-05-15-add-cma-support.md`

## Template

```markdown
# Spec: <title>

**Status:** draft | in-progress | done
**Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
**Author:** <name>

## Problem

What are we solving and why?

## Proposed Solution

What are we building?

## Out of Scope

What are we explicitly NOT doing?

## Open Questions

- [ ] Question 1
```
